children: Bitcoin mining pool OCEAN said co-founder Luke Dashjr has left the company and resigned as chairman, chief technology officer, and director after both sides agreed to part ways. According to Odaily, OCEAN repurchased all of Dashjr's equity, and the split stemmed from differences over the future of Bitcoin mining. Dashjr will join the new project CONVOY, while OCEAN said it will continue serving miners through a transparent, non-custodial mining pool.

title: Bitcoin Mining Pool OCEAN Says Co-Founder Luke Dashjr Has Left Company
